title: DeepVision-103K: A Visually Diverse, Broad-Coverage, and Verifiable Mathematical Dataset for Multimodal Reasoning
authors_zh: Haoxiang Sun, Lizhen Xu, Bing Zhao, Wotao Yin, Wei Wang, Boyu Yang, Rui Wang, Hu Wei
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** DeepVision-103K provides about 103K visually diverse, decontaminated K–12 math problems with rule-verifiable final answers.
DeepVision-103K 提供约 10.3 万道视觉多样、去污染且最终答案可规则验证的 K–12 数学题。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal mathematical datasets are often small, visually homogeneous, or generated from repetitive templates, allowing models to rely on text transcription rather than understanding geometry diagrams, plots, tables, and scientific illustrations. Other large collections lack dependable answer verification and decontamination, contaminating SFT and RLVR with noisy labels.

DeepVision-103K collects and synthesizes K–12 visual mathematics with broad knowledge-point and visual-element coverage, difficulty control, and decontamination, then retains verifiable items through answer parsing and rule checks for multimodal SFT, RLVR, and evaluation.

多模态数学数据通常规模小、图像类型集中或来自重复模板，模型容易依赖文本转录而非真正理解几何图、函数图、表格和科学示意图。另一些大规模集合缺少可靠答案验证与去污染，导致 SFT 和 RLVR 奖励混入错误标签。

DeepVision-103K 面向 K–12 数学汇集并生成视觉题，强调知识点和视觉元素覆盖、难度与去污染，再用答案解析和规则校验保留可验证样本，形成适合多模态 SFT、RLVR 与评测的数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DeepVision-103K releases roughly 103K visual mathematics problems. Core records combine an image, question, reference answer, and provenance or topic metadata, spanning diverse K–12 knowledge points and visual forms. Its feedback contract parses final answers into comparable objects and applies deterministic mathematical rules, enabling direct outcome rewards for RLVR. The current official dataset page is under skylenage/DeepVision-103K, so older organization paths should not be treated as the sole reference.
DeepVision-103K 公开约 10.3 万道视觉数学题，核心记录包含图像、问题、参考答案及来源/主题等元数据，覆盖多种 K–12 知识点和视觉形式。其数据合同是把最终答案解析为可比较对象，再由确定性数学规则判断正确性；因此可直接提供 RLVR 终局奖励。官方数据页当前位于 skylenage/DeepVision-103K，候选表中的旧组织名不应继续作为唯一链接。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build source coverage: Aggregate public visual-math problems and supplement them with synthetic items by knowledge point, difficulty, and image type to avoid dependence on one geometry template.
  1. Create visuals and answers: Attach charts, geometric figures, or scientific illustrations, generate or curate reference answers and necessary derivations, and preserve topic and provenance metadata.
  1. Deduplicate and decontaminate: Screen textual, answer, and image near-duplicates and compare against common multimodal-math benchmarks to remove likely leakage.
  1. Parse and verify: Normalize answers into numbers, expressions, or options and apply mathematical consistency rules; remove records that cannot be parsed reliably or whose visual and text content disagree.

1. 构建题目来源： 汇集公开视觉数学题，并按知识点、难度和图像类型补充合成问题，避免数据集中于单一几何模板。
  1. 生成视觉与答案： 为题目配套图表、几何图或示意图，生成/整理参考答案和必要解析步骤，并记录主题与来源。
  1. 去重与去污染： 对文本、答案和图像近重复进行筛查，并与常用多模态数学评测集比较，删除潜在泄漏。
  1. 解析并验证： 将答案规范化为数值、表达式或选项，使用数学规则检查一致性；无法稳定解析或视觉—文本不匹配的样本被过滤。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The release contains about 103K items and reports distributions over visual types, mathematical topics, difficulty, and decontamination. Training experiments show that SFT or verifiable reinforcement on the data improves several visual-math benchmarks while retaining general capabilities, and ablations identify scale, visual diversity, and verification filtering as important factors. This supports training utility but does not prove every image semantics and reference solution correct; model and compute budgets must be controlled in comparisons.
数据规模达到约 103K，并系统报告视觉类型、数学主题、难度和去污染统计；训练实验显示使用该数据进行 SFT 或可验证强化后，多模态模型在若干视觉数学基准上提升，同时保持一般能力。消融把数据规模、视觉多样性和验证过滤作为关键因素。结果支持数据有训练效用，但未逐题证明图像语义和参考解完全正确，且不同模型的训练预算需控制后再比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier visual-math datasets usually scale question count or rely on a single figure generator. DeepVision-103K jointly optimizes visual diversity, knowledge coverage, difficulty, decontamination, and parseable answers under one construction contract. The novelty is large-scale verifiable multimodal data engineering rather than a new vision encoder, reasoning search, or reward optimizer.
已有视觉数学数据多扩充题量或使用单一图形生成器。DeepVision-103K 的变化是同时优化视觉多样性、知识覆盖、难度、去污染和可解析答案，并把这些要求作为统一数据构建契约。新意主要在大规模可验证多模态数据工程，而不是新的视觉编码器、推理搜索或奖励优化算法。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Outcome-only reward: Final-answer rules cannot detect visual-understanding or intermediate-reasoning errors; a model may exploit textual shortcuts and still receive reward.
  1. Synthetic artifacts: Rendering style, layout, or text placement may create shortcuts and differ from real textbooks, hand drawings, and low-quality scans.
  1. Scope boundary: The collection emphasizes K–12 tasks with normalizable answers and has limited coverage of proofs, open modeling, and multi-answer problems; users must check the exact licence and version.

1. 答案级奖励： 规则校验最终答案不能发现视觉理解错误或中间推理错误；模型可能通过文本捷径得到正确结果。
  1. 合成伪影： 图像生成风格、排版或文字位置可能形成捷径，与真实教材、手绘图和低质量扫描存在差距。
  1. 范围限制： 以 K–12 和可规范化答案为主，对证明题、开放建模和多解问题覆盖有限；复用需核对具体许可与版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Multimodal SFT/RLVR: Train from image, question, and reference answer with normalized-answer rewards, and separately report missing-visual, OCR, and computation errors.
  1. Visual-coverage studies: Bucket by image type and knowledge point and compare text-only, shuffled-image, and full inputs to verify that gains do not come from prompt shortcuts.
  1. Dataset auditing: Reuse deduplication and answer-parsing procedures for new visual-math corpora. Add symbolic verifiers or human rubrics for proofs and open-ended tasks.

1. 多模态 SFT/RLVR： 用图像、问题和参考答案训练，奖励由规范化答案比较给出，并分别报告视觉缺失、OCR 和计算错误。
  1. 视觉覆盖研究： 按图像类型和知识点分桶，比较文本-only、图像打乱和完整输入，确认模型提升并非题干捷径。
  1. 数据审计： 复用其去重与答案解析流程检查新视觉数学集；证明题或开放题需增加符号验证器或人工量规。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: DeepVision-103K provides about 103K visually diverse, decontaminated K–12 math problems with rule-verifiable final answers.
  1. Method hook: The key is multi-source or synthetic scaling, visual and knowledge coverage control, cross-modal deduplication, and answer-parsing filters.
  1. Data hook: Records center on image, question, answer, and topic or source metadata; the current official page is skylenage/DeepVision-103K.
  1. Evidence anchor: Training and ablations support scale, visual diversity, and verification filtering, but no step-level correctness is guaranteed.
  1. Reuse decision: It fits multimodal-math SFT and RLVR. Run image-shuffling tests, OCR audits, and version/licence checks first.

1. 一句话定位： DeepVision-103K 提供约 10.3 万道视觉多样、去污染且最终答案可规则验证的 K–12 数学题。
  1. 方法抓手： 核心是多源/合成扩展、视觉与知识覆盖控制、跨模态去重以及答案解析过滤。
  1. 数据抓手： 记录以 image、question、answer 和主题/来源元数据为主，官方当前发布页为 skylenage/DeepVision-103K。
  1. 证据锚点： 训练与消融支持规模、视觉多样性和验证过滤有效，但没有步骤级正确性保证。
  1. 复用决定： 适合多模态数学 SFT 与 RLVR；使用前需做图像打乱测试、OCR 审计和版本许可确认。
